text:
What is an advantage of the fermentation process for producing ethanol compared with the
catalytic addition of steam to ethene?
A
Fermentation requires less heat energy.
B
Ethanol from fermentation needs to be distilled.
C
Raw materials for fermentation are non-renewable.
D
The fermentation process is carried out in batches rather than continuously.

options.label: B
options.text: Ethanol from fermentation needs to be distilled.

options.label: C
options.text: Raw materials for fermentation are non-renewable.

options.label: D
options.text: The fermentation process is carried out in batches rather than continuously.
